headline: Buyers hit pause
as rates top *7%*
slides.sub: The slowest October for new contracts since 2018, and the steepest annual drop since August 2023.

slides.label: yearly jump in the typical mortgage payment, now *$2,004 a month*
slides.body: It rose 4.8% from September alone, the biggest one-month jump in four years. Rates averaged 7.33% in October vs. 6.86% in September, while home values are up just 0.7% year over year.

slides.title: Home sales decline, *Oct. vs. a year ago*
slides.note: Buffalo was the only major metro with *a gain (+1%)*. Chicago home values led the nation, up 4.8% year over year.

slides.title: The low point *may be close*
slides.body: Zillow expects November to slow further and December to mark the bottom. With inventory up 3.4% from last year, any dip in rates could bring sidelined buyers back fast. Keep in touch now.
